title: 1.3 Two People: und and sie
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Join two people with und and tell one person from two by the verb ending: sie liest / sie lesen.
grammar_function: Person und person + plural verb; Sie + plural verb; sie + singular vs plural verb.
prerequisite: German 1.1-1.2: the four people, der/die/das, and isst, liest, schreibt.
speaking_outcome: Say what one or two people are doing.

cards.pedagogy_note: und joins two people.
